lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: What ya cut the hair off with?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: The knife you guys found in the garage?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: It's impossible. You took her out to the garage and that's when you got the knife. Explain how that can be. (pause) Did you cut her hair off?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Then why did you just tell us you did? Brendan?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Didn't you ask us to come here and talk to you? Yes or no?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Why did you ask us to come here? So you could lie to us? So you could tell us the truth? When you gonna start that? What do you think your mom would say if she knew you were sitting here lying to me?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: You think she'd be okay with that?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Do you remember what your mom said in court last week.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK, should I refresh your memory? Your mom said that Brendan doesn't lie and that Brendan never lies to police officers. Do you remember her saying that?
